sources.entry: pyzipper - Read and write AES-encrypted ZIP files (zipfile fork).

summary.one_liner: pyzipper is a zipfile replacement for reading and writing AES-encrypted ZIP archives in Python.
use_cases: create password-protected zip archives from Python
read AES-encrypted zip files in scripts
compress files with LZMA into encrypted archives
choose AES-128, AES-192 or AES-256 zip encryption
drop-in replacement for zipfile when AES is needed
notable: Provides AESZipFile with the same API as Python 3.7's zipfile
Supports WZ_AES encryption with 128, 192 or 256-bit strength (default 256)
Supports ZIP_LZMA compression among zipfile compression methods
From v0.4.0, no CRC32 values are written to headers by default
caveats: Based on the Python 3.7 zipfile API, so it lacks pathlib-compatible wrappers from Python 3.8
Versions before v0.4.0 had a bug that included CRC32 values for small files
